title: The critical exponent for the two-dimensional semilinear wave equation with strong damping
summary: In this manuscript, we determine the critical exponent for the two-dimensional semilinear wave equation with strong damping. A recent result in D'Abbicco (arXiv, 2026) gives global in-time small data solutions for $p>\frac{10}{3}$, whereas we in the paper prove finite-time blow-up for $2<p\leqslant\frac{10}{3}$ under an averaged sign condition on the initial velocity.
